children: Tenri City, Nara Prefecture, Sept 28, 2026 - (JCN Newswire) - Sharp Semiconductor Innovation Corporation (Headquarters: Tenri City, Nara Prefecture; President: Hiroaki Fujino; hereinafter referred to as "SSIC") has begun mass production and shipment of photocoupler (*2) products using paper reels as packaging material in place of the plastic reels previously used.

In recent years, the electronic components industry has been accelerating supply chain-wide efforts to reduce environmental impact, driven by tightening environmental regulations and growing interest in ESG investment. At manufacturing sites for factory automation (FA) and consumer equipment, demand for environmentally conscious component supply is increasing, and the transition from plastic to paper-based packaging materials is advancing. This switch to paper reels is a response to these societal demands.
